proves.claim: A claim of a dependent whose after-gate parent is submitted with a green gate at its submitted head is accepted and records the parent id and head under board_meta after_gate_base.

store.io-board-claim.after-gate-green-pa.why: A dependent can start on a gate-green parent instead of waiting for it to land, building on the parent's submitted head.

proves.claim: A claim whose after-gate parent has a red, running or stale-head gate, and a claim whose plain --after parent is only submitted, are each refused BLOCKED.

store.io-board-claim.not-green-or-plain-.why: Only a parent proven green at its submitted head may be built on early; every other wait still blocks.
